answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46351 Country: India Title: Ia it Right Question: Once it was the day of Jumuah, I was sitting in mosque and listening to Khutbah, I saw a person in the first row was sleeping deeply and the voice coming out from his nose, and when someone wake him up he didn't repeat wudhu, and now Imam stands for Namaz after compilation of Khutbah, other person who was just behind the Imam was reading the Taqbeer and he stuck (could not loud out) the words 'Qadka Matissalah tu Qadka Matissalah'. And now the person who was in deep sleep while Khutbah, help him and complete the remaining takbir (Qadka..... Allahu Akbar....La Ilaha Illallah..). I want to ask that. Kya Hum Sab Ki Namaz Ada Ho gai Ya Nahi..... Answer ID: 46351 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1122/868/H=9/1434) Salah was valid and complete. However, iqamah was completed by two persons, it was makrooh. If after qad qamatis salah the next sentence was not remembered and he could not say it instead of reiteration then it was better for the other person to say iqamah from the beginning. However, it caused no karahat in your salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
